Four test files call `findEnclosingSgSymbols` directly, by importing it from `../src/sg.js`:

1. `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`
2. `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
3. `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
4. `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

There's also one indirect route. The `ast_search` tool calls this function at `src/sg.ts:415`, but only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1` is set. The only test file that sets that variable and runs `ast_search` is `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`, already listed above, in its "derives enclosing symbols before display range merging" test.

Other `ast_search` tests (for example `sg-output.test.ts` and `sg.args.test.ts`) leave the variable unset, so they never reach `findEnclosingSgSymbols`.

<answer>
tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts
tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts
tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts
tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts
</answer>
